question: A man walks 7 km in west direction and then turns to his right and walks 7 km and then turns to his left and walks 5 km. Finally turns to his left and walks 7 km. How far and in which direction is he from his starting point?
solution:
The distance and direction diagram is according to the given data:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/17da0760afd6b721598180392bfc490b13e803b33166d45a76c304f9911b2443.png] 

Here, O is the starting point and D is the endpoint and the distance between O and D is 12 km.

The direction of D from O is West.

Here, the distance and the direction of D from O is **12 km in the west**.

Hence,** Option(2) **is the answer.
